pages.text: Gear to full diamond minimum — Terrasteel or Enderium recommended — before touching Tier 3 bosses, the most varied roster in the pack: Meet Your Fight superbosses, Cataclysm ultra-bosses, the Cardinal Sins ladder, the Wither and the Warden.$(br2)The Cardinal Sins end in $(bold)Lucifer$(), the Tier 3 combat capstone and the last name on its boss rush: clearing all of it opens Tier 4.

$(bold)The Cardinal Sins$()$(br)The seven sins and Drakara have their arenas in $(bold)the Abyss$(); Lucifer's is in $(bold)the Nether$(). The Boss Compass finds each one.$(br2)Every shrine takes the previous sin's Soul Orb and works once: Sloth → Gluttony → Lust → Greed → Envy → Wrath → Pride → Lucifer's Atrocity Shrine. Drakara needs no shrine: it waits in its arena, underground.

$(bold)Soul Orbs$()$(br)Sloth's Malevolichite Shrine takes a $(bold)Soulweaver Orb$(): 8 Malevolichite around an Eye of Ender. Malevolichite Ore sits in the floating pillars of the Overworld's Forgotten Forest.$(br2)Every other orb: an Eye of Ender and the Essence the previous sin drops, at a smithing table with no template.

$(bold)Terramity's Chthonic Cathedral$() (the Nether)$(br)Occult Fabric on its Offering Pedestal calls $(bold)Enchanter Merlin$() and $(bold)Sorceress Circe$() together; when Circe falls, $(bold)Archmage Gundalf$() appears. Merlin and Circe count toward the Tier 3 boss rush.$(br2)Occult Fabric comes from Gatmancers and conjurlings, and sometimes from the Chthonic Dungeon's chests.

$(bold)Meet Your Fight$() — 4 superbosses in specialized biomes:$(br)Swampjaw → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Harbinger$(/l) (18%)$(br)Bellringer → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Hearthflame$(/l) (18%)$(br)Dame Fortuna → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiscythe$(/l) (18%)$(br)Rosalyne → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magispear$(/l) (18%)

$(bold)Wither$() — Drops: 2 Nether Stars, Wither Bones, 2 Runic Tablets, 3 Rift Shards, a Void Fragment, often an Advanced Reforging Token, $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulkeeper$(/l) (15%). Your first Wither also drops the Dormant Relic. With two or more players near, it drops a loot bag of those spoils for each player instead.

$(bold)Cataclysm Bosses$()$(br)Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The Harbinger, The Leviathan, Maledictus — 5 ultra-bosses in massive Cataclysm structures. Each drops a unique weapon and boss material. The hardest T3 content.$(br2)$(bold)Warden$() (Vanilla)$(br)Deep Dark. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Stormbringer$(/l) (20%).
